text:
Kai: Quick sync — after yesterday's customer call we need to re-evaluate the launch trajectory. Customer A pressed hard for per-tenant SSO and CSV analytics export. We can't do both + current infra improvements by our GA date without increasing risk. Proposing a scope re-bucket.

Maya: Agree we need to be surgical. Two angles: (1) keep GA date, reduce surface for MVP; or (2) shift GA by 3 weeks to include SSO. Which has lower business cost?

Rene: From infra side, per-tenant SSO adds auth flows + KMS integration + e2e tests. Realistic for dedicated pilot in ~6 weeks, not 2. Analytics export is lighter but touches RBAC & permissions. Also need another round of perf tests after KV cache tweak.

Jordan: Design can produce lightweight SSO flows (OIDC only) quickly, but product UX for admin export needs more polish. If we cut analytics from MVP, it's less visible to customers.

Kai: My preference is keep GA date but trim MVP. Let's define clear buckets (MUST / SHOULD / NICE) and owners so nobody's expectations are fuzzy. If we accept a small, gated SSO pilot for one customer that's OK.

Maya: Proposed buckets (quick):
```
MUST (MVP): core inference API, latency SLOs, basic multi-tenant RBAC, docs, billing
SHOULD (early v1): per-tenant SSO pilot (OIDC), analytics export (CSV), improved batching tunables
NICE (post-v1): full SSO with KMS/HSM integrations, scheduled exports, tenant-level dashboards
```

Rene: +1. Engineering asks:
- Freeze model rollout for GA (no risky new model variants)
- Prioritize KV cache perf patch (blocks cost targets)
- Leave SSO pilot behind a feature flag and manual rollout to one account

Jordan: UX notes: for the SSO pilot we need an admin onboarding checklist + a minimal admin UI. I can ship the checklist in 1 sprint, UI in 2.

Kai: OK decision: keep GA date, adopt Maya's bucketing. Move analytics export to SHOULD, SSO pilot to SHOULD behind a flag, full SSO to NICE. We'll keep the GA date but add a contingency: if KV cache perf doesn't pass canary by 3/31 we delay GA by 2 weeks.

Maya: I'll update the milestone tracker and owners. Proposed milestones (rough):
- 3/20: feature freeze for GA surface
- 3/27: perf canary + KV cache patch verification (Rene)
- 4/03: docs + billing verification (Kai / Maya)
- 4/10: gating decision (go/no-go)

Rene: I'll run a perf matrix and post results to the milestone thread. If perf is marginal we do the 2-week slip.

Kai: Action items:
- Maya: update tracker + notify sales/CS of scope change and pilot offer
- Rene: perf runs + PR for cache patch (#4581)
- Jordan: admin checklist + minimal UI mockups
- Kai: draft customer comms for GA scope and pilot invite

release-bot: Created ticket #4920 "Launch-scope: MVP buckets and contingency" and linked PR #4581.

Maya: Noted. I ping sales to adjust expectations and will post updated milestone board by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Rene: Starting perf runs now, will share numbers in the thread.

Kai: Thanks team — this feels actionable. We'll reconvene next week if any canary surprises come up. :thumbsup:
